en: Black‑and‑white view of a busy early‑20th‑century urban street lined with multi‑story commercial buildings. Pedestrians and horse‑drawn vehicles move along a wide boulevard. Large shop windows and signage appear on the left, including a bold storefront sign reading something like "PAHLAAS." The architecture is typical of central‑European stone or stucco façades with ornamented cornices.
